The density of a gas is 9×10^(− 2) kg/m^3 and root mean square velocity of gas molecules is 400 m/s . The pressure exerted by the gas on the walls of the vessel is

(A) 4556 N/m^2
(B) 8225 N/m^2
(C) 7520 N/m^2
(D) 4800 N/m^2
